description: Opt-in: subscribe to `param.changed` events for an operator's parameters. When a watched parameter's value changes in TouchDesigner (by a human or a script), the bridge broadcasts a {path, par, prev, value, frame} event on the TD event stream, forwarded to the MCP client as a logging notification. Use action='watch' to register (optionally scoped to named `parameters`), 'unwatch' to remove, and 'list' to see active watches. Events only arrive when the server's TD event stream is enabled (TDMCP_EVENTS); param.changed is treated as a high-frequency event (coalesced bridge-side so a slider drag can't flood). Survives TDMCP_BRIDGE_ALLOW_EXEC=0.

action.description: 'watch' registers a subscription, 'unwatch' removes it (or just the named parameters), 'list' returns all active watches.

parameters.description: Optional list of parameter names to watch (e.g. ['opacity','level']). Omit to watch every parameter on the operator.

path.description: Operator path to watch for parameter changes, e.g. /project1/level1. Required for action='watch'/'unwatch'; omit for action='list'.

name: watch_parameter_changes

action.description: The action that was performed: watch, unwatch, or list.

count.description: Number of active watches (for the 'list' action).

parameters.description: Parameters now watched on this op, or null for a watch-all subscription.

watching.description: Whether an active watch remains on this op after the action.

title: Watch operator parameter changes
